description: ParcelPal 1.2.10 remote-update edition. Resolves H5 order-page loading upon commit when Ultron data is ready, and automatically transitions picked-up parcels from awaiting pickup to picked up across Taobao, Cainiao, Fengchao, and courier tracks.
name: 包裹助手（远程更新）

localizedDescriptions.zh: 1.2.10 远程更新版：1) 淘宝 H5 订单页在 commit 后检测到订单数据立即完成加载；2) 驿站/快递柜取件后（菜鸟 SIGN、丰巢出柜、淘宝及各快递出库签收文案）自动从「待取」转为「已取」。
localizedDescriptions.en: 1.2.10 remote-update edition. Completes Taobao H5 order-page loading upon commit when Ultron data is ready, and automatically transitions picked-up parcels from awaiting pickup to picked up.
